name: Al-Shatrah

queries.query: Al-Shatrah Iraq cadastral parcel map land registry official
queries.result: First-party Iraqi Ministry of Justice contact material identifies a dedicated Al-Shatrah real-estate registration directorate; the official Ur service provides deed and property-map requests, but the public workflow is not an anonymous parcel viewer.

queries.query: الشطرة العراق خارطة عقارية تسجيل عقاري دائرة التسجيل العقاري
queries.result: وزارة العدل العراقية lists مديرية تسجيل عقاري الشطرة. The official Ur service describes requesting a سند وخارطة للعقار and requires an authenticated owner/service workflow; no public parcel geometry endpoint was found.

registryEvidence: The Iraqi Ministry of Justice first-party contact page explicitly lists مديرية تسجيل عقاري الشطرة (Al-Shatrah Real-Estate Registration Directorate) under the Dhi Qar registration offices.
